notes: This was close between Adventure and Shooter: the squad's long, short, heavy and medium range roles against plasma-armed aliens is PvE shooter material, but the map is organised around a long storyline, a main investigation, side quests and travel between locations rather than around firing corridors, so Adventure leads and Shooter is named second for the combat options. Shape is world-open because the author settled that Ayush Forest is the whole playable world holding about six locations, which is one contiguous map rather than separate chapters, so it stays on P0 despite the storyline. Quest Hub is the preset that already carries the main and side quest board, the progression gate, and fast travel — the dropship unlocked by an early main quest is exactly teleporter-link — and I added collectible-nodes for the resources found across the forest, landmark-focal for the six locations that give exploration its pull, and Shooter's spawner-npc for the alien territory. Without a user I read the safe landing-zone base as one staging spawn rather than a town, so it is spawn-protected, and kept cover-los because range-differentiated squad roles need sightline breaks to mean anything; the mech, the AI command wheel and the travel fast-forward are mechanics, not layout.
